item.subject: science
item.stem: For a school project, Meera compares two planets. Planet X is closer to the Sun than planet Y, and both have similar thick atmospheres that trap heat in the same way. Which statement correctly predicts their general temperatures?

options.A: Planet Y must be hotter because it is farther from the Sun.
options.B: Planet X is generally hotter because it receives more energy from the Sun.
options.C: Both planets must have exactly the same temperature because their atmospheres are similar.
options.D: The temperatures cannot be predicted at all, even when the atmospheres are similar.
